M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
A portable electronics organizer built on 4 hex cells in a 2×2 tapered block:

- **Base with removable bins for small parts**: Cells `0,0` and `0,1` hold drop-in tray bins `bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2` (2 compartments) and `bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div3` (3 compartments) — removable, subdivided for resistors/caps/screws. Cell `1,0` is capped with `cover:1,0,0;full;top` to serve as a flat work surface; cell `1,1` uses a `half-n` base to reduce bulk for portability. Additional bins can be added to remaining cells.
- **At least one drawer**: `drawer:0#-1,1#cut` fitted to the cut face of `piece:-1,1,0;half-n` (south-facing) provides enclosed drawer storage for cables/tools.
- **Carry handle**: `handle:0,0,0;top` mounted on `cover:0,0,0;full;top` (with 3 inserts) spans the central base for one-handed carry. Build is 5 parts total (4 bases + drawer + 2 covers + 2 bins + handle), meshClash clear, portable.
